title: TracePOS Windows Code Signing Configuration Template
description: Template configuration for Trace POS Authenticode Code Signing. Copy to signing_config.json and populate with your credentials. NEVER COMMIT REAL CREDENTIALS TO GIT.

trustedSigning._comment: Microsoft Trusted Signing (formerly Azure Trusted Signing / Microsoft Artifact Signing). Recommended for production.
trustedSigning._comment_dlib: Optional: Path to Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll. If empty, script searches standard Windows SDK / NuGet paths.

pfx._comment: Standard Authenticode PFX Certificate (OV/EV exported with private key). Keep in secure local path outside git repo.

certStore._comment: Windows Certificate Store (CurrentUser or LocalMachine), used for Hardware Tokens (USB Dongles / HSM via CSP/PKCS#11).
